items.headline: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Albemarle, Sociedad Quimica and Rio Tinto
items.snippet: ALB expects lithium demand to witness a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030. Stationary storage is expected to be a significant driver for lithium demand along with EVs.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Global lithium consumption was up 45% year-over-year through May, tracking above forecasted range, driven by continued strength in stationary storage and improving growth in electric vehicles. Needed supply increases are coming to market slower than demand growth.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB) will likely benefit from factors like its low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, as well as continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties, RBC Capital Markets said. RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $1

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $161 from $189 at Morgan Stanley
items.snippet: Morgan Stanley analyst Vincent Andrews lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $161 from $189 and keeps an Equal Weight rating on the shares. Lithium prices have come off this cycle's peak.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics.

items.headline: Here's How to Play Albemarle Stock Before Q2 Earnings Release
items.snippet: Falling lithium market prices are weighing on ALB stock. Lithium prices have pulled back amid slowing demand for electric vehicles (EVs) in China, an inventory glut and prospects of increased supply from mine restarts and capacity additions.
